annotations.title: Answer from a verified fact dataset

description: Answer a question from a curated dataset of facts that Search1API has collected from many sources and cross-checked, instead of searching the open web. Use it when the question falls in a listed dataset: gta6 covers GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) gameplay, such as missions, vehicles, weapons, money, collectibles, properties, controls, settings and performance, and bugs and fixes. Each result is one short fact with its relevance, a confidence score, how many independent sources state it, whether sources disagree (with the competing claims), and source links to cite. When found is false the dataset has no answer: say so or use search, and do not present the closest facts as the answer. Costs 1 credit only when found is true.

dataset.description: Dataset to query: gta6 for GTA 6 gameplay

query.description: The player's question in natural language, with any platform or version in the question itself; non-English questions are translated before matching

name: query_dataset

found.description: Whether the best fact answers the question; when false the results are only the closest facts

query_en.description: English translation used for matching, for non-English questions

results.description: Facts ordered by relevance. title is the fact, url its best source, and metadata holds relevance, confidence, corroborated_by, contested, conflicting_claims, the answered question, all sources and dataset attributes

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: Answer from a verified fact dataset
